Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.text

Class GetTextWrapper

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.text.GetTextWrapper
@Component public class GetTextWrapper extends Object
Provides OCR text extraction functionality from image regions with mock support.

This wrapper class abstracts optical character recognition operations, extracting text from Match objects and their associated image regions. It integrates with Sikuli's OCR capabilities while providing a consistent interface for both real and mocked text extraction.

The class handles two main workflows:

  • Batch processing: Extract text from all matches in an ActionResult
  • Individual processing: Extract text from a single Match

In mock mode, text extraction uses probabilistic models based on match history rather than actual OCR, ensuring realistic test behavior without requiring actual image processing.

  • Method Details

    • getAllText

      public void getAllText(ActionResult matches)
      Extracts text from all matches in the action result and updates both the matches and result.

      This method processes each match in the provided ActionResult, performing OCR on their associated image regions. Extracted text is stored in two places:

      • In each individual Match object via Match.setText(java.lang.String)
      • In the ActionResult's string collection for aggregate access

      In mock mode, text is generated based on match history probabilities. The mock system ensures that repeated calls don't artificially increase success rates, maintaining realistic test behavior.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult containing matches to process. This object is modified by adding extracted text strings to its collection.

    • getTextFromMatch

      public String getTextFromMatch(Match match)
      Retrieves text from a match, using either existing text or mock generation.

      In real mode, returns any text already stored in the match object. In mock mode, generates text based on the match's history and probability models. This method doesn't perform OCR; it retrieves previously extracted text.

      Parameters:
      match - The match object to retrieve text from
      Returns:
      The text associated with the match, or mock-generated text in mock mode
      See Also:
      • Match.getText()
      • MockText.getString(Match)

    • getText

      public String getText(Match match)
      Performs OCR on the match's image region and returns the extracted text.

      This method directly invokes Sikuli's OCR engine on the BufferedImage contained within the match. Unlike getTextFromMatch(io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.match.Match), this method performs actual text recognition rather than retrieving stored text.

      If the match doesn't contain a valid image, returns an empty string.

      Parameters:
      match - Must contain a valid BufferedImage in its image field
      Returns:
      All recognized text as a single string, or empty string if no image is available or no text is detected
      See Also:
      • invalid reference 
        OCR#readText(BufferedImage)
      • Match.getImage()

    • setText

      public void setText(Match match)
      Performs OCR on the match's image and updates the match with the extracted text.

      This convenience method combines getText(io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.match.Match) with Match.setText(java.lang.String), performing OCR and immediately storing the result in the match object. This ensures the match contains the most current text from its image region.

      Parameters:
      match - The match to process. Must contain a valid image for OCR. The match's text field will be updated with OCR results.
